name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
provider_bias: US federal scope; lists a CVE only with reliable exploitation evidence and a remediation path, so it trails exploitation
time_contract: dateAdded is CISA's listing date, not first exploitation; dueDate is the federal remediation deadline
used_for: Vulnerabilities page, edge-device lens, ladder, Brief; Weaponization timing against KEV listing

name: CVE List V5 records
provider_bias: CNA-supplied scoring varies in quality and completeness
time_contract: datePublished is CVE publication; CVSS from the CNA first, then ADP
used_for: CVSS, CWE, publication-to-KEV lag, data-gap flags

name: CISA Vulnrichment (ADP)
collection_method: Feed: ADP container inside CVE records
provider_bias: Covers CVEs CISA chooses to enrich
time_contract: SSVC decision points as of the ADP update

name: CISA ICS advisories (CSAF 2.0)
provider_bias: Vendor-coordinated disclosures only; sector and geography as the vendor reports them
time_contract: initial_release_date is CISA publication

name: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20
provider_bias: Built from public reporting; overlap between groups is curated, and attribution is quoted from cited sources
time_contract: modified is the object's last change; release dates bound the diff
used_for: Actors, techniques, release diff, campaigns; Defense page: techniques, group use, mitigations, detection strategies and analytics, data components; sector targeting from group descriptions

name: MISP galaxy threat actors (with CFR tracker fields)
provider_bias: Volunteer-curated; CFR fields reflect the Council on Foreign Relations tracker's public sourcing
time_contract: No event time; reflects curation state
used_for: Second-curator attribution beside ATT&CK; Defense page: targeted-sector field for sector relevance

name: CVSS-BT enrichment (EPSS and exploit signals)
provider_bias: Aggregates FIRST EPSS, CISA KEV, VulnCheck KEV, Exploit-DB, Metasploit, Nuclei and PoC-in-GitHub; inherits each upstream's coverage
time_contract: published_date is CVE publication; flags reflect the daily build
used_for: EPSS, weaponization rung, pre-KEV early warning

name: FIRST EPSS (via CVSS-BT)
collection_method: Derived: model score carried in CVSS-BT
provider_bias: Statistical estimate of exploitation activity in the next 30 days; it does not measure impact
time_contract: Score as of the CVSS-BT build date

name: VulnCheck KEV (via CVSS-BT)
provider_bias: Broader evidence threshold than CISA, includes exploitation reported by researchers and vendors
time_contract: Flag as of CVSS-BT build date

name: Metasploit modules (via CVSS-BT)
collection_method: Derived: flag carried in CVSS-BT; and the repository's commit history, read by fetch_weaponization.py, for the date each exploit module was first added
provider_bias: Module existence shows weaponization, not use in the wild
time_contract: Flag as of CVSS-BT build date; module date is the first commit adding it, followed through exact renames

name: Nuclei templates (via CVSS-BT)
collection_method: Derived: flag carried in CVSS-BT; and the repository's commit history, read by fetch_weaponization.py, for the date each CVE template was first added
provider_bias: Template existence enables mass scanning; shows weaponization for discovery
time_contract: Flag as of CVSS-BT build date; template date is the first commit adding a file named for the CVE
